data.name: Sathisha
data.gender_notes: Sathisha is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sathisha is recorded with the meaning “Truth”. Sathisha is a Hindu name meaning “Truth”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sathisha expresses “Truth”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sathisha total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
